office.name: ADOT MVD Commercial Vehicle Permits (Class A) / ADOT Class C Permits Office

fees.note: Class A single trip, excess size only: $15 (Class A covers up to 14' W, 16' H, 120' L, 250,000 lb).
Class A single trip, excess weight or size + weight: $75 (A.R.S. 28-1105(A)(2)-(3)).
Class C (beyond the Class A envelope): $30 at <=80,000 lb, $90 over 80,000 lb. Valid 4 working days.
Class C triggered by height over 16': $30 / $90 over 80,000 lb.
Class C triggered by length over 120': $30 / $90 over 80,000 lb.
Class C triggered by gross over 250,000 lb: $90.
Class C greater than 18 ft: $40 at <=80,000 lb, $100 over 80,000 lb. ADOT wording 'greater than 18 feet in height and width' read as either dimension - verify.
Class C greater than 18 ft high: $40 / $100 over 80,000 lb.

Engineering/bridge analysis $125 per 50-mile increment (modeled as $2.50/mi, min $125; rounding up to whole increments not modeled). Also charged below 250,000 lb when axle weights exceed R17-6-411 Tables 3.01-3.09 or posted bridge limits - not modeled.

restrictions.text: Over 10' wide: no continuous travel - move 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset; night (from 3:00 a.m.) and weekend moves only on Table 4 routes designated for night/weekend transport (up to 16' W, 16' H, 120' L, 250,000 lb). Keep 2,000 ft from other permitted loads.
Over 14'6" high: daylight only (1/2 hr before sunrise to 1/2 hr after sunset) except Table 4 night/weekend routes up to 16' high.
Over 120' long: daylight only; night/weekend/holiday moves only if approved on the Class C permit.
Over 250,000 lb: daylight only; night/weekend/holiday moves only if approved on the Class C permit.

Holiday ban (also applies over 14'6" H, 10' front/rear overhang, 120' L, 250,000 lb): no moves on New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas; stop at 12 noon the day before (Thursday or Friday for weekend holidays) and resume 1/2 hr before sunrise the day after.

Metro curfew (Phoenix and Tucson listed routes), Mon-Fri 7:00-9:00 a.m. and 4:00-6:00 p.m.: over 10' wide either needs a rear escort (10-12' on some Phoenix routes) or may not move (over 12', and all over 10' on listed Tucson I-10/I-19 segments).

travel.weekends: No travel on Saturday or Sunday
travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
travel.note: Night/weekend moves only on ADOT Table 4 routes.

notes: Legal height is 14' (13'6" on Table 4 restricted routes). Legal width 8'6" (8' on some restricted routes). Legal length: 57'6" semitrailer on the National Network, 53' (or 65' overall) elsewhere; overhang 3' front / 6' rear.
Class A single trip covers up to 14' W, 16' H, 120' L, 250,000 lb; anything beyond is a Class C permit (valid 4 working days, ~48 h processing).

Escorts are route-specific (R17-6-305 + R17-6-412 Table 4). Modeled from the dominant Table 4 pattern: over 14' wide = rear escort on most interstate segments, front+rear on most US/state routes. Many US/state segments require front+rear from 10' or 12' wide - check Table 4 for the actual route.
Night escorts (3:00 a.m. to 1/2 hr before sunrise, R17-6-402): over 11-14' wide rear; over 14-16' front+rear; over 15' high front with height pole.

Law enforcement (DPS) escorts are required only where Table 4 or the Class C permit says so (max two per R17-6-412(E)); no general dimension trigger. Route survey/contingency plan is decided case by case for Class C (R17-6-108).
Class A permits are valid on state routes only; city/county roads need local permits (e.g., City of Phoenix).
